Accommodation
Beaufort West Self-catering accommodation at its best.
The night sounds of jackal calling create the ambiance of Africa and make this a nature lover s paradise. The nine A-Frame chalets, built from stone, timber and thatch offer the ideal family accommodation for this perfect hideaway.
This is Beaufort West luxury self-catering accommodation at its best. The secluded bush camp consists of 2 Luxury self-catering chalets, 7 Standard self-catering chalets, a Lounge/Conference Centre, Bar and Boma.  Surrounded by rocky craggs and the Nuweveld Mountains, Ko-Ka Tsara is the ideal destination for your Karoo stay.
Luxury Chalets
Two spacious 76m double volume self-catering chalets offering open plan lounge, dining area and fully equipped kitchen. The main bedroom is fully air conditioned and has king size bed and modern bathroom with shower. The timber mezzanine floor has 2 single beds.
Each chalet has a private under cover patio with braai area. The chalets are in a unique, beautiful setting, surrounded by pristine Karoo bush veld and mountains.
Check availability & book online
Standard Chalets
The self-catering chalets were designed and built by the game farm owner, Werner Koster, who exclusively used local poplars and stone for their construction. The Rustic décor is completed by slate floors, hand made furniture and wood finishes.
The thatched A-frame chalets are stylishly decorated and sleep a family of four.  Each has an en-suite bathroom, fully equipped kitchen and own private braai (barbeque) facility.
The units offer 2 x ¾ beds downstairs and 2 x single beds on a mezzanine floor.
Each chalet has its own private parking area and is comprehensively furnished including air conditioners for summer and heaters for winter.
Ko-Ka Tsara Bush Camp is child and pet friendly.

Bush Camp
Catering
Catering for larger groups, in true Karoo style next to a cozy campfire in the open air Boma, can be arranged. To complement the fine Karoo cuisine, we have a fully licensed bar stocked with local beers, cooldrinks, spirits and superb local wines for the discerning client.
All the chalets have fully equipped kitchens for a self-catering holiday, including a private braai area.
Ko-Ka Tsara Bush Camp has excellent conference facilities and is the perfect venue for weddings, team building weekends and bosberade for up to forty people. Our staff are well trained, friendly and neat, and will efficiently see to your every whim.
Meals to order
A choice of lamb, chicken or beef braaipacks, freshly prepared salads and braai broodjies are available for order at the Camp.
